description: Upcoming token unlocks ACROSS THE MARKET when no single coin is named: each row has date, days until, coin, tokens, USD value, % of market cap, recipients and insider (team + investor) share, with its source. Defaults: next 7 days, top 500 coins, at least 0.5 % of market cap, ranked by % of market cap. Only coins DropsTab tracks; each recipient's next release only. Answers "biggest unlocks this week?", "big VC unlocks this month?". For one coin use get_unlocks.

insidersOnly.description: Only unlocks with a team or investor leg.

maxRank.description: Only coins up to this market-cap rank (default 500).

minPct.description: Minimum size in % of market cap (default and floor 0.5).

sort.description: pct = biggest share of market cap (default), usd = biggest dollar value, date = soonest.

name: get_unlock_calendar
